title: The $113M Sacrifice That Won New York A Ring: Will KAT Follow Brunson's Lead?
description:
The New York Knicks won the 2026 NBA championship because Jalen Brunson sacrificed $113 million. Now they're asking Karl-Anthony Towns to do the same. Will the big man take a discount to keep the core together, or will he demand his full $272 million max extension and force the Knicks to break up their title team? We dive deep into the financial chess match that will define New York's dynasty hopes, the Mitchell Robinson loss to the Celtics, and whether the culture of sacrifice Brunson built can survive the second apron era. This is the story of legacy versus money in the biggest market in basketball.
